description: This file declares a cache interface for the PyTorch JIT fuser, including functions for normalizing graphs, storing and retrieving graph-based kernel specifications, and inspecting cache size.

methods.name: normalizeGraphForCache
methods.description: Normalizes a computation graph by canonicalizing and erasing shape information to prepare it for caching.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Stores a given graph in the cache and returns a key associated with it.

methods.name: lookupGraph
methods.description: Finds a KernelSpec based on the provided graph.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves the graph associated with a given cache key, if it exists.

methods.name: debugNumCachedKernelSpecs
methods.description: Returns the current number of cached KernelSpecs, mainly for testing purposes.
